channel.title: Fort Worth Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fort Worth Magazine (fwtx.com)

item.title: Drew Medford Memorial Baseball Tournament Returns to Fort Worth for 10th Year
item.description: The three-day event honoring former Paschal and TCU player Drew Medford brings 29 teams to seven North Texas sites while continuing its scholarship mission for student-athletes.

item.title: McKale Montgomery Made Cowtown Marathon History — and She Owes It to a Basketball
item.description: This Fort Worth runner is the first woman to ever win The Cowtown Ultra Marathon, but she gives credit where credit is due

item.title: The Winged and the Exotic Take Over the Botanic Garden
item.description: Butterflies in the Garden, which showcases thousands of colorful winged insects from around the globe, runs through April 30 at the Fort Worth Botanic Garden.

item.title: Experiencing the West Through Burl's Brush
item.description: As Buffalo Soldiers, Black cowboys, and pioneering women receive renewed recognition, this artist has been telling their overlooked stories for decades.

item.title: Colonial Celebration To Mark 80 Years of PGA Tour Golf in Fort Worth
item.description: Put this on your calendar. Past champions will gather March 26 at Tannahill’s to honor Colonial Country Club’s legacy and support Fort Worth Colonial Charities.

item.title: One Needn’t Be a Savant to Enjoy The Modern’s New Exhibit, ‘A Poem for Deep Thinkers’
item.description: Rashid Johnson’s grand touring exhibition will occupy the walls of The Modern from March 8 to Sept. 27.

item.title: Sweet Sugar High Lands Permanent Spot on North Side
item.description: The popular smashburger food truck will move into its new home this month.

item.title: Could Texas Republicans Repeat the Mistake That Elected John Tower in 1961?
item.description: Political fractures inside the Texas GOP could create the same kind of opening that allowed Republican John Tower to win a U.S. Senate seat in 1961.

item.title: Casa Mañana Unleashes ‘Hairspray’ — and Its Uplifting Message Is Likely to Stick
item.description: As ‘Hairspray’ ends its run at Casa Mañana this weekend, we chat with the show's leading lady about the can't-miss musical and how much literal hairspray their wig designer burns through.

item.title: After Medical Emergency, GoFundMe Launched to Support Bowie House GM and His Family
item.description: Gaylord Lamy, who's been the only general manager of the Auberge Collection hotel, suffered a heart attack in late February.
